data.name: Description_MagRail_TrackGroup
data.value: Blocks that carry the maglev track.

data.name: Description_MagRail_WideTrackGroup
data.value: Blocks of the wide (2 m) maglev track.

data.name: Description_MagRail_RailBlock1
data.value: Straight rail, 1 block long. Rails placed end to end join by themselves.

data.name: Description_MagRail_WideRailBlock1
data.value: Straight wide rail (2 m), 1 block long. Rails placed end to end join by themselves, of any type; the Rail Linker lays spans only between wide rails.

data.name: Description_MagRail_WideRailBlock5
data.value: Straight wide rail (2 m), 5 blocks long. Rails placed end to end join by themselves, of any type; the Rail Linker lays spans only between wide rails.

data.name: Description_MagRail_WideFreeRail
data.value: Wide rail (2 m) with a turning head: any direction, slope and bank. The Rail Linker lays spans only between wide rails.

data.name: Description_MagRail_RailBlock5
data.value: Straight rail, 5 blocks long. Rails placed end to end join by themselves.

data.name: Description_MagRail_RailBlock10
data.value: Straight rail, 10 blocks long, on platforms at its ends. Rails placed end to end join by themselves.

data.name: Description_MagRail_RailBlock20
data.value: Straight rail, 20 blocks long, on platforms at its ends. Rails placed end to end join by themselves.

data.name: Description_MagRail_FreeRail
data.value: Rail with a turning head: any direction, slope and bank.

data.name: Description_MagRail_Switch1
data.value: One entry, three branches: left, centre, right, all leaving the front end from one point. The branches are the spans laid from it with the Rail Linker (aim beside the end for the left and right one); the switch sends a train into the selected one.

data.name: Description_MagRail_WideSwitch1
data.value: Wide rail switch (2 m), 1 block long. One entry, three branches: left, centre, right, all leaving the front end from one point. The branches are the spans laid from it with the Rail Linker (aim beside the end for the left and right one); the switch sends a train into the selected one.

data.name: Description_MagRail_EngineGroup
data.value: Engines that hold a train over the rail.

data.name: Description_MagRail_HoverLarge
data.value: Holds the train over the rail. Mount it under the wagon. Placeholder model.

data.name: Description_MagRail_HoverSmall
data.value: Holds the train over the rail. Mount it under the wagon. Placeholder model.

data.name: Description_MagRail_HoverMini
data.value: Small hover engine for light small-grid trains. Placeholder model.

data.name: MagRail_Term_Height_Tip
data.value: Height of the rail above the bottom of the block. Only an unlocked block can change it.

data.name: MagRail_Term_Yaw_Tip
data.value: Direction of the rail. + = to the right.

data.name: MagRail_Term_ResetHead_Tip
data.value: Turn, slope and bank back to 0.

data.name: MagRail_Term_Branch_Tip
data.value: Where a train coming from the entry goes.

data.name: MagRail_Term_LockedNote
data.value: A rail (not a prototype) ends at this block: switch it to prototype with the Rail Linker to change height or head.

data.name: Description_Item_MagRail_RailLinker

data.name: MagRail_Linker_AimNothing

data.name: MagRail_Linker_Started

data.name: MagRail_Linker_PickedUp

data.name: MagRail_Linker_RailFirst

data.name: MagRail_Problem_PortRail
data.value: the port has a rail (switch it to prototype first)

data.name: MagRail_Problem_Style
data.value: a span joins only rails of one type

data.name: MagRail_EngineTerm_Height_Tip
data.value: Height of the guide point (block centre + offsets) over the rail point. Standard 2.5 m (small grid 1.2 m).

data.name: MagRail_EngineTerm_Hold_Tip
data.value: How hard the engine pulls its point back over the rail. 1x standard; more = stiffer, less = softer.

data.name: MagRail_EngineTerm_OffsetRight_Tip
data.value: Moves the point held over the rail to the block's right (negative = left).

data.name: MagRail_EngineTerm_OffsetForward_Tip
data.value: Moves the point held over the rail to the block's front (negative = back).

data.name: MagRail_EngineTerm_OffsetUp_Tip
data.value: Moves the point held over the rail up (negative = down).

data.name: MagRail_Engine_State_Far
data.value: Rail: found, too far (hover height ±4 m)

data.name: MagRail_Engine_State_Tilted
data.value: Rail: found, engine not upright to it

data.name: MagRail_Engine_State_TrackEnd
data.value: Rail: past the end of the track

data.name: MagRail_Engine_Info_Hold
data.value: Engine force (full thrust): {0}; holds the rail with {1}

data.name: MagRail_Drive_NoController
data.value: Drive: no cockpit to take the direction from

data.name: MagRail_Drive_Sideways
data.value: Drive: ERROR: the cockpit faces across the rail

data.name: MagRail_Drive_PropulsionOff
data.value: Propulsion is off: this engine does not push

data.name: Description_MagRail_TrainControl
data.value: Put it on the grid of the train's cockpit: it gives the train the vanilla inertia dampeners (Z) and the cruise control. Dampeners on: release W/S and the train brakes to a stop and holds. Off: it coasts. Cruise: its toolbar actions hold the speed. Model of the AI Flight block (placeholder).

data.name: MagRail_Control_Info
data.value: Gives the grid's cockpits the inertia dampeners (Z) for the train.

data.name: MagRail_Drive_NoControlUnit
data.value: Dampeners (Z): no Train Control Unit on the cockpit's grid

data.name: MagRail_Cruise_BtnSet_Tip
data.value: Switches the cruise on at the train's current speed.

data.name: MagRail_Cruise_BtnResume_Tip
data.value: Switches the cruise on at the remembered speed (the current one if there is none).

data.name: MagRail_Cruise_BtnCancel_Tip
data.value: Switches the cruise off; the speed is remembered.

data.name: MagRail_Cruise_Speed_Tip
data.value: The speed the cruise holds, m/s, up to the world's max ship speed; it does not switch the cruise on. The cruise pushes the way this block pushes: shown after its name in the block list (Forward = forward of the cockpit). Each unit has its own cruise, but only one works on a train at a time.

data.name: Description_MagRail_Autopilot
data.value: Drives the train to its stations along the track, with the switches as they are. Stop the train with the block over a place and press Remember: that is a station. Slows down before curves. Model of the AI Recorder block (placeholder).

data.name: MagRail_Ap_DrivingMax
data.value: driving to {0}, {1} m to go · {2} m/s (max speed)

data.name: MagRail_Ap_DrivingStation
data.value: driving to {0}, {1} m to go · {2} m/s (braking for the station)

data.name: MagRail_Ap_DrivingCurve
data.value: driving to {0}, {1} m to go · {2} m/s (curve R {3} m)

data.name: MagRail_Ap_DrivingAccel
data.value: driving to {0}, {1} m to go · {2} m/s (speeding up)

data.name: MagRail_Ap_ErrNoEngine
data.value: no hover engine of the train holds the rail

data.name: MagRail_Ap_ErrNoRoute
data.value: the station cannot be reached with the switches as they are

data.name: MagRail_Ap_ErrRouteLost
data.value: the way to the station is broken (a switch, a rail)

data.name: MagRail_Ap_Go_Tip
data.value: Drives the train to the selected station.

data.name: MagRail_Ap_Stop_Tip
data.value: Stops the autopilot at once: the train is the pilot's again.

data.name: MagRail_Ap_Stations_Tip
data.value: Up to 10 stations. Select one to rename it, move it, delete it or pick its timer.

data.name: MagRail_Ap_Remember_Tip
data.value: Adds the rail point under this block as a new station.

data.name: MagRail_Ap_Move_Tip
data.value: Moves the selected station to the rail point under this block.

data.name: MagRail_Ap_Timer_Tip
data.value: The timer block triggered when the train arrives at the selected station.

data.name: MagRail_Ap_MaxSpeed_Tip
data.value: The autopilot's top speed, m/s. Before curves it slows down by itself.

data.name: MagRail_Ap_Accel_Tip
data.value: How fast the autopilot speeds the train up, m/s² (1-50). The engines may give less (thrust over mass).

data.name: MagRail_Ap_Brake_Tip
data.value: How hard the autopilot plans to brake for the station and before curves, m/s². Set it no higher than the engines can brake the train, or it overshoots and backs up.

data.name: MagRail_Ap_Lateral_Tip
data.value: Before a curve the autopilot slows down so that the side force (v²/R) stays within this, until the whole train has left the curve. No limit: curves do not slow it (the rail holds the train in any curve). 1 g: R 160 m - 40 m/s, R 1000 m - 99 m/s; 3 g: R 160 m - 69 m/s.

data.name: MagRail_Ap_Park_Tip
data.value: Puts the train's hand brake on when it arrives.

data.name: MagRail_Ap_ShowGps_Tip
data.value: Shows the stations as GPS marks (only to you, not saved).

data.name: MagRail_Tune_Section
data.value: MagRail: drive tuning (test; saved with the world; works when this controller drives the train)

data.name: MagRail_Tune_Hud_Tip
data.value: While you drive the train from here: drive state, speed, deceleration, stopping distance, mass. Single player. Default off.

data.name: MagRail_Tune_BrakeFactor_Tip
data.value: Each braking engine brakes with this many times its thrust (its Power slider), up to the most below. Default x2: Power 10% brakes with 20% of the force, 50% and more with 100%.

data.name: MagRail_Tune_BrakeShare_Tip
data.value: The most an engine brakes with, share of its force (100% = its full thrust). Default 100%.

data.name: MagRail_Tune_BrakeMax_Tip
data.value: The grid's deceleration at most. Default 100 m/s².

data.name: MagRail_Tune_BrakeRise_Tip
data.value: Time for the brake to rise from half to full force after Space is pressed. 0 = full force at once. Default 0.5 s.

data.name: MagRail_Tune_SoftStop_Tip
data.value: Below this speed the Space brake weakens with the speed (down to 10% at a standstill). 0 = off (default).

data.name: MagRail_Tune_Disturbance_Tip
data.value: The brakes cancel last tick's push along the rail (slope, couplers) up front, within their force. Default on.

data.name: MagRail_Tune_ParkShare_Tip
data.value: Share of each parked engine's force (100% = its full thrust; the engine needs Braking and Parking on). Default 150%.

data.name: MagRail_Tune_ParkMax_Tip
data.value: The grid's deceleration at most while parked. Default 100 m/s².

data.name: MagRail_Tune_RestAccel_Tip
data.value: A grid nearly standing that nothing pushes is held by this weak brake. Default 0.49 m/s² (about a 5% slope).

data.name: MagRail_Tune_RestSpeed_Tip
data.value: The rest hold works below this speed. Default 0.30 m/s.

data.name: MagRail_Tune_ThrustShare_Tip
data.value: An engine's thrust at 100% Power, share of its force (power at full thrust stays the engine's max power). Default 100%.

data.name: MagRail_Tune_ThrustMax_Tip
data.value: The grid's acceleration by thrust at most, the dampeners too. Default 100 m/s².

data.name: MagRail_Tune_Reset_Tip
data.value: All drive tuning values of this controller back to the defaults.

data.name: MagRail_Tune_HudLine
data.value: {0} · {1} m/s · decel. {2} m/s² · stops in {3} · {4} t

data.name: MagRail_Tune_ParkStopsDrive_Tip
data.value: While the hand brake of this controller's grid is on, W/S pushes no grid of the train (else the wagons push the parked locomotive). Default on.
